interaction_moduleDescription: Notification channels of the users (in-app, browser, Telegram) and questions with answers.
interaction_enabledKinds_description: The in-app channel is always on. Other kinds need their provider.
interaction_inappDisplayDefault_descript: How a notice shows while the app is open, for users who did not choose.
interaction_defaultTimezone_description: Time zone of the quiet hours of users who did not choose one (IANA name).
interaction_maxPerUserHour: External deliveries per user and hour
interaction_maxPerUserHour_description: Info and security notices; beyond, only the in-app notice is kept.
interaction_askMaxPerUserHour: Question cards per user and hour
interaction_askMaxPerUserHour_descriptio: External deliveries of questions; beyond, only the in-app question is kept.
interaction_providerTimeoutMs_descriptio: A channel slower than this is recorded as TIMEOUT; the others are not delayed.
interaction_askDefaultTtlSeconds_descrip: Used by the apps that do not give an expiry.
interaction_askMaxTtlSeconds_description: A question expiring later is refused.
interaction_expirySweepMs_description: Expired questions are closed and their outcome handed over at this pace (workers only).
interaction_emailCodesPerUserHour: E-mail codes per user and hour
interaction_emailCodesPerUserHour_descri: Verification codes of the e-mail channel (when a provider is installed).
interaction_emailCodesPerIpHour: E-mail codes per address and hour
interaction_emailCodesPerAddressDay: E-mail codes per recipient and day
interaction_emailCodesPerAddressDay_desc: Per destination address (only a hash is stored).
interaction_testsPerUserHour: Test sends per user and hour
interaction_testsPerUserHour_description: « Send a test » button of the channels.
interaction_testsPerIpHour: Test sends per address and hour
interaction_linkCodesPerUserHour: Telegram link codes per user and hour
interaction_telegramMode_description: Which bot the users link their Telegram account to.
interaction_telegramInbound_description: Long polling by default; the webhook also needs the route enabled by the app.
interaction_telegramStartRepliesPerHour: Answers to /start per bot and hour
interaction_telegramStartRepliesPerHour_: A stranger sending codes never makes the bot talk much.
interaction_linkCodeTtlMinutes: Validity of a Telegram link code (min)
interaction_emailCodeTtlHours_descriptio: For the e-mail channel (when a provider is installed).
interaction_vapidSubject_description: mailto: address or https URL given to the push services; empty = the sender address of the e-mails.
interaction_noticeRetentionDays_descript: In-app notices older than this are deleted.
interaction_ticketRetentionDays_descript: Counted from the closing of the question.
interaction.server.answeredElsewhere.tit: A question was answered outside the app
interaction.server.answeredElsewhere.bod: Answer « {action} » given through {via}. If it was not you, unlink that account and check your channels.
interaction.server.dispatchFailed.title: An answer could not be handed over
interaction.server.dispatchFailed.body: The outcome of a question of kind {kind} could not be handed to the app after 5 attempts.
interaction.server.telegramLinked.title: New Telegram account linked
interaction.server.telegramLinked.body: A Telegram account was linked to your notifications. If it was not you, remove it in your channel settings.
interaction.server.test.title: Test notification
interaction.server.telegram.test: Test notification: this Telegram channel works.
interaction.server.telegram.answerInApp: Answer this question in the app.
interaction.server.telegram.card.expired: Expired: no answer was given in time.
interaction.server.telegram.card.cancell: Cancelled: this question no longer needs an answer.
interaction.server.telegram.press.inacti: This button is no longer active.
interaction.server.telegram.link.linked: Telegram account linked: your notifications will arrive here.
interaction.server.telegram.link.already: This Telegram account is already linked to your account.
interaction.server.telegram.link.conflic: This Telegram account is linked to another user: linking refused.
interaction.server.telegram.link.limit: Too many Telegram accounts are linked: remove one in the app first.
interaction.server.telegram.link.invalid: Unknown or expired code: ask for a new link in the app.
